articles.title: Space Dragon Returns With Cool Science!
articles.summary: A SpaceX Dragon is coming back from the space station with thousands of pounds of science samples. It's bringing stuff that could help make better cancer treatments and space fuel!

articles.title: Meet Lucy's Hunter: A Giant Croc That Terrorized Our Ancient Relatives!
articles.summary: Scientists found a new crocodile species that lived 3 million years ago in Africa. It was huge—up to 15 feet long—and probably hunted Lucy and her kind!

articles.title: Lost Notebooks Solve a 55-Million-Year-Old Fish Mystery!
articles.summary: A fossil fish found in 1999 was a mystery until the scientist's lost notebooks were found. They helped identify it as a tarpon—a predator that lived 55 million years ago!
